environment.description: Kubernetes pod running the stream processor as PID 1 with full filesystem access. The encryption key file at /etc/secrets/stream-encryption.key is mounted from a Kubernetes Secret. The process has network access to Kafka brokers and can read/write to /var/spool/processed/. No filesystem isolation beyond standard container boundaries. An attacker who compromises the Kafka topic can observe multiple ciphertexts encrypted with the same key+nonce pair, enabling XOR of plaintexts to recover payment data.
